note: The first runner reads this file and opens html: the game hub, so the runner always lands on the games. All four chairs work the same way: arena/(build) is Pindutan, chess/(chessBuild) is Chess, three/(threeBuild) is Zumang, fortress/(fortressBuild) is Fortress, and each game updates itself from its own field. menu/menuBuild let the hub keep itself current. The hub asks for the password before any game opens; the games themselves start at the nickname. To publish a new build: put it on main, then bump the matching tag here. Set "ladder" to a full https address to move the leaderboard to a host of its own; leave it empty to keep api-leaderboard.php on aidekupal.unaux.com.
